gen-gf-turret-road-space-grotesk: Space Grotesk draws each glyph as a ribbon of constant width, its counters breathing, under the bold display forms of Turret Road. Rounded swagger above, geometric restraint below: that difference is what holds attention.
gen-gf-underdog-fs-amulya: Amulya feels modern and contemporary, its curves never crowding. Underdog stamps every stroke at one gauge, and over pages of text the body's generous gaps keep lines flowing without clogging.
gen-gf-underdog-fs-synonym: Loud, wide-mouthed letters from Underdog, then Synonym settles into a dependable stripe of constant ink with generous openings. Paragraphs of it would glide along without a snag.
gen-gf-underdog-space-grotesk: Space Grotesk lays down a ribbon of constant width, with counters that breathe open beneath the horseshoe c of Underdog. Both draw one steady line, yet one shouts while the other murmurs.
gen-gf-unkempt-fs-chillax: Relaxed is the mood of Chillax, all spaghetti lines and unfinished loops. Unkempt, above it, keeps its t crossbar and stem matched in weight, so a commanding top sits over a loose, easygoing bottom.
gen-gf-unkempt-fs-plein: Unkempt marks every t with a crossbar and stem of matching weight, and its gaps keep c from collapsing into o. Unkempt grabs attention, while Plein channels the eye smoothly into each round letter.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-fs-alpino: Stencil bridges between letters make Snowburst One loud, tall, and impossible to ignore. Alpino handles the quieter work, cozy and casual, with curve endings kept well apart and short-looking ascenders.
gen-gf-tektur-fs-nunito: Pipe-cleaner strokes of constant width give Tektur its outsized, distinctive look. Nunito does the gentler, approachable work, with big round bowls and terminals that stop short of the stem.
gen-almendra-display-gf-cascadia-code: Almendra Display brings an ornate, literary voice with a pronounced x-height. Cascadia Code, wire-thin and monoline with wide gaps between neighbors, carries running text along smoothly, each bend unobstructed.
gen-flavors-satoshi: Satoshi has a soaring x-height and uniformly cut strokes, a friendly base under the whimsical, commanding Flavors. Both stand tall in x-height, so heading and text feel closely related.
